summary: Materialized and read complete Greek ARIST-MET-VIII-6. H.6 plus q104 house/material-natures explanation supplies the strongest inspected positive constitutive candidate, conditional on a defended bearer criterion; neither actual form nor proximate-matter terminology independently guarantees the whole without circularity. Full basis must include actual arrangements and relevant conditions. Local existence of THIS composite is a possible constitutive explanandum, not merely function, while global actuality and infinite realization remain unestablished. Walked foundations reply through actual materials, arrangement/natures, instrumental efficacy and universal participation; q104 integrates constitution with conservation but its universal divine application inherits prior God/essence-esse/participation commitments. Rejected all-dependence-is-routing, component existence equals absent actuality, conditional constitution as global realization, and finite examples as infinite evidence. Complete proposed assessment, opposing commitments, exact concrete-support mapping, reversal conditions and next discriminating test persist in docs/notes/aristotelian-unity-h6.md. No new claim, vocabulary, theorem, model or root-premise change; semantic challenge and final delivered-head CI remain required.
blocker: Independently defend an actual bearer constitution criterion and full obtaining basis without encoding its existence into actual-form/proximate-matter labels; map that basis faithfully to the same actual concrete existential-support relation. Then discriminate current efficient conservation/universal participation from a genuinely source-free global constitutive realization. The sources and structural controls inspected do not complete that application; finite constitution does not warrant infinite actuality.
